title: N11 claimed folded but the retry budget is dead code — GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES exists nowhere and the stage machine still polls unbounded
evidence:
retries:  int, // N11: the condition-poll frame budget (GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES)
...
case .Draw_Release:
	if !pipe_live(app) {
		gallery.wait = 5 // the commit lands via the executor — poll
		return false
	}
(.Noc): if !app.overlay_on || !app.stats_valid { ... gallery.wait = 5; return false } — the full 307-line post-image (canonical diff, whole file one +hunk) contains exactly ONE occurrence each of 'retries' and 'GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES': this declaration comment. The field is never read or written; no such constant is defined.
detail: Skin-deep fold of r1 N11: the fix commit added a never-referenced field plus a comment naming a nonexistent mechanism, while the unbounded condition polls (Draw_Release/Noc/Deselect/Settings) still re-arm forever. The code now claims a safety budget that does not exist.
recommended_fix: Implement the budget — define GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES, increment per failed poll in gallery_frame, abort with the stage name — or delete the field and rewrite the comment honestly.

title: Audio seam refactor DELETED rl.CloseAudioDevice from teardown instead of wrapping it — a behavior change on normal builds, with audio_destroy's doc comment now false
detail: The lens-guard mandates the seam preserve #86's teardown behavior. r1 kept the device close (when/else-gated); the wrapper refactor dropped it entirely, so normal builds never close the audio device while the proc comment still says 'close the device'.
recommended_fix: Add audio_close_device to the seam (no-op under PP_SW_AUDIO, rl.CloseAudioDevice otherwise) and call it at the end of audio_destroy.

title: N9 claimed folded but the gallery is still a package-level mutable global and project-context.md documents no debug-global carve-out
location: app/gallery.odin:63; project-context.md (read in full at the reviewed worktree)
evidence: gallery: Gallery  // file-scope declaration; the whole file sits inside 'when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) {' — project-context.md at the reviewed sha (read in full; 'Last Updated: 2026-08-08', not in the diff): "**No globals / singletons.** Everything hangs off `App` → `Run_State`, passed by pointer (ODN-13)." — no gallery/debug-global carve-out appears anywhere in the file.
detail: Neither of N9's two fix options (hang Gallery on App, or document the debug carve-out) happened, yet the fix commit claims N1-N15 folded. The debug-only mutable global persists undocumented against ODN-13.
recommended_fix: Move Gallery onto App behind #config(PP_DEBUG), or add the debug-global carve-out sentence to project-context.md.

title: N10 claimed folded but nothing in-repo produces PP_SW_AUDIO — and audio.odin's comment points at a gallery.odin doc that documents no such build
detail: The SW app build (raylib-sw shadow + PP_SW_AUDIO=true) that produced the A/B gallery evidence remains irreproducible from the repo, and the comment's documentation pointer is false — the claimed N10 fold did not happen.
recommended_fix: Add the app SW build line (ODIN_ROOT=$SHADOW odin build app -define:PP_SW_AUDIO=true ...) to build_raylib_sw.sh or to gallery.odin's header.

title: build_probe_set re-implements rnd.font_codepoints — two hand-rolled copies of the same 96-codepoint set can silently drift
detail: The debug probe set must mirror the shipped atlas set; a future atlas change (e.g. a new symbol) leaves font-check silently grading a different codepoint set.
recommended_fix: Delete build_probe_set and call rnd.font_codepoints() (the harness already imports rnd for FONT_BASE_SIZE/FONT_ASSET).
